4efc408bf2d250e6.description: About the Role King Abdullah bin Abdelaziz University Hospital (KAAUH) is seeking a Medical Laboratory Technologist II to perform a variety of laboratory procedures. This full-time role operates within the established Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and aligns with the mission, vision, and values of KAAUH. The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Perform duties in compliance with international and national accreditation standards, including JCIA, CAP, AABB, CBAHI, and KAAUH Laboratory Standards. Execute day-to-day bench duties and lead a workgroup within the assigned section. Conduct patient sample analysis and proficiency surveys as required. Assist the Manager/Supervisor with staff scheduling and oversee the work and performance of technical personnel. Contribute to generating, maintaining, and updating section Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). Provide training and guidance to Medical Laboratory Technologist III and Medical Laboratory Technician II & III staff to enhance their skills and knowledge. Participate in section/department educational programs and assist in training students and new staff. Monitor section equipment function, perform preventive maintenance, and troubleshoot instrument malfunctions. Ensure thorough documentation of section quality improvement activities. Analyze laboratory computer applications for data management. Participate in teaching, training, verification, competency testing, and Continuing Medical Education (CME) activities. Assist in evaluating new equipment and staying informed on developments in Laboratory Technology. Contribute to inventory management, request supplies, and ensure cost-effective utilization of materials, reagents, and supplies. Identify technical, instrumental, and/or physiological causes of unexpected test results. Adhere to work schedules, including assigned shifts and on-call duties. Promote a patient-centered care culture by respecting patients and their families. Participate in and support quality improvement and patient safety activities. Perform other job-related duties and on-call duties as assigned. Compliance and Quality Standards The Medical Laboratory Technologist II will ensure all duties are performed in strict compliance with Hospital policies and safety standards. A commitment to upholding the highest standards of quality and patient safety is essential for this role. Required Experience A minimum of 2 to 5 years of experience in a medical laboratory setting is required. Professional Development This role involves active participation in educational programs and continuous professional development, including training new staff and contributing to ongoing medical education activities. Application Process Interested candidates are invited to apply for this full-time position. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

4e0980ff46351677.description: About the Role Elsewedy Electric Power Systems Projects is seeking a Construction Team Leader Mechanical to join their team in Makkah, with operations covering Jeddah and Makkah. This full-time role involves leading and mentoring the mechanical site engineering team and workforce, ensuring efficient project execution in line with established schedules. Role Purpose The primary purpose of this position is to lead, direct, and mentor the mechanical site engineering team and workforce by example. This includes ensuring seamless inter-team coordination, transparent communication of work plans, and constraint-free execution in adherence to baseline project schedules. Key Responsibilities Understand mechanical construction scope and objectives, involving the team, and ensuring technical feasibility. Determine project phases and their scheduling based on baselines provided by the construction manager. Prepare method statements required for construction activities. Review risk assessments to ensure compliance with method statement requirements. Manage relationships between the team, the client, and all stakeholders. Oversee dealings with mechanical sub-contractors and other necessary personnel. Ensure the availability of equipment and materials required for construction activities. Issue detailed constructability plans based on site conditions to support the project baseline schedule. Resolve issues that may arise during plan execution, including weather conditions or emergencies, which could delay project completion. Ensure resource availability, allocate, and source materials, equipment, and manpower for assigned mechanical construction work, ensuring productivity and compliance. Adopt and implement all company processes and procedures involved in construction. Manage working teams, allocate tasks to relevant personnel, and request team recruitment when needed. Report and escalate issues to Construction Management as required. Measure construction team performance using available tools and techniques. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of relevant experience in construction. Demonstrated ability to lead, direct, and mentor engineering teams and workforces. Strong understanding of mechanical construction scope and objectives. Proficiency in preparing method statements and reviewing risk assessments. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Makkah, with project responsibilities extending to Jeddah. The role requires active on-site leadership and coordination within a dynamic construction environment.

4e16f0e24cd57ec6.description: About the Role Tamer Services Company (TSC) is seeking an experienced Compliance Director to join a leading integrated healthcare and wellness group. This full-time position is based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. The role focuses on strengthening the organization's compliance framework, managing regulatory risk, and fostering a culture of ethics and integrity across all business units. Role Overview The Compliance Director will be responsible for defining, executing, and overseeing the organization's comprehensive compliance program. This involves close collaboration with leadership to identify and mitigate regulatory risks, ensuring adherence to ethical standards, integrity, and accountability throughout the organization. Key Responsibilities Design, implement, and continuously improve corporate compliance policies, procedures, and governance frameworks. Conduct regular compliance risk assessments, identify regulatory gaps, and implement effective mitigation strategies. Monitor compliance across business operations, investigate potential violations, and oversee corrective and preventive actions. Partner with Legal, Finance, Operations, and HR to ensure organization-wide compliance with applicable regulations and internal policies. Act as the primary point of contact for regulatory authorities, external auditors, vendors, and consultants. Deliver compliance awareness initiatives and training programs to reinforce ethical conduct across the organization. Prepare executive-level compliance reports, dashboards, and recommendations for senior leadership. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of experience in a compliance role. Demonstrated analytical and structured approach to compliance. Proven ability to manage regulatory risk and develop compliance frameworks. Career Opportunity This role offers direct exposure to senior leadership and executive committees, providing an opportunity to lead and strengthen a critical corporate compliance function. It involves cross-functional collaboration with Legal, Finance, Operations, and HR, and represents a long-term career opportunity within a respected and growing healthcare organization.

4e20d39bd4705ab8.description: About the Role Sheraton Hotels & Resorts is seeking an Engineer Shift to join their team in Medina, Al Madinah. This full-time position involves responding to guest repair requests, performing preventive maintenance, and ensuring the operational efficiency of hotel equipment and systems. The role requires 0-1 years of experience in a related field. Key Responsibilities Respond to and address guest repair requests promptly, communicating effectively to resolve maintenance issues. Perform preventive maintenance on tools, kitchen equipment, and mechanical room equipment, including cleaning and lubrication. Visually inspect tools, equipment, and machines for proper function and identify potential issues. Identify, locate, and operate all shut-off valves for equipment and utility shut-offs for buildings. Maintain maintenance inventory and requisition parts and supplies as needed. Communicate daily activities and problems to other shifts using approved communication programs and standards. Perform surface preparation, painting, minor drywall and wood trim repair, light bulb and A/C filter replacement, and ensure thorough cleanup of work areas. Test, troubleshoot, and perform basic repairs on various equipment, plumbing (*, plunging toilets, unclogging drains), and electrical components. Program TVs and perform general housekeeping and engineering-related inventory duties. Utilize the Lockout/Tagout system before commencing any maintenance work. Perform repairs on interior and exterior landscaping, including external landscaping sprinklers. Safety and Operational Compliance Adhere to all company, safety, and security policies and procedures. Report any maintenance problems, safety hazards, accidents, or injuries. Complete required safety training and certifications and properly store flammable materials. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional. Maintain confidentiality of proprietary information and protect company assets. Guest and Team Interaction Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards, anticipating and addressing service needs. Assist individuals with disabilities and thank guests with genuine appreciation. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with colleagues, supporting team goals, and responding appropriately to concerns. Communicate with others using clear and professional language. Required Skills and Physical Demands Basic knowledge or ability to acquire knowledge in air conditioning and refrigeration, electrical, mechanical, plumbing, pneumatic/electronic systems and controls, carpentry, kitchen equipment, and general building maintenance. Basic computer skills, including inputting air handler schedules and making temperature changes. Ability to move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing up to 50 pounds without assistance, and heavier objects with assistance. Capability to move up and down stairs, service ramps, and/or ladders. Ability to reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Proficiency in entering and locating work-related information using computers. Experience and Work Environment Candidates should possess 0-1 years of relevant experience. This is a full-time position based in Medina, where the Engineer Shift will perform duties as requested to support the hotel's operations and guest satisfaction.

4e73c2a0ba37da04.description: About the Role Parsons Corporation is seeking a Senior Architect to join our team in Riyadh, Riyadh. This full-time position involves providing essential support in design management, coordination, and technical leadership across various project stages. Key Responsibilities Support Senior Management and the Senior Design Manager in the daily management, coordination, and assurance of design delivery throughout all project stages. Coordinate design consultants and technical teams to ensure compliant, integrated, and high-quality design outputs. Review and monitor design submissions for quality, completeness, coordination, and alignment with project requirements before approvals. Support the resolution of design clashes, technical queries, constructability issues, and cross-disciplinary coordination matters. Maintain design trackers, action logs, registers, approval workflows, and technical records to support effective governance and reporting. Apply standardized design management templates, tools, methodologies, and reporting procedures across assigned projects. Monitor design progress against agreed milestones, schedules, and stage gate deliverables. Coordinate interfaces between disciplines, infrastructure systems, assets, consultants, stakeholders, and delivery teams to ensure integrated outcomes. Identify, track, and support the mitigation of design-related risks, assumptions, constraints, and dependencies. Liaise with internal stakeholders, consultants, support functions, and project teams to facilitate timely reviews, approvals, and decision-making. Ensure accurate, timely, and consistent communication of design information across all stakeholders. Required Experience Candidates for this position should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in architecture and design management. Work Environment This is a full-time role based in Riyadh, where the Senior Architect will contribute to a dynamic team environment focused on design delivery and project coordination.

4e8fa1828448cf1f.description: About the Role Robusta is seeking an Enterprise Solution Architect to join the Octopus by RTG team. This full-time, on-site position is based in KSA and requires over 10 years of experience. The role focuses on translating business requirements and Enterprise Architecture principles into secure, scalable, and end-to-end technology solutions. Role Overview The Enterprise Solution Architect will define solution architecture across application, data, integration, security, and infrastructure domains. This involves ensuring alignment with the organization's target architecture, standards, and regulatory requirements. The architect will collaborate with Business Architects, Application Architects, Data Architects, Security Architects, Infrastructure Architects, and technical teams to support transformation, modernization, and application rationalization initiatives. Key Responsibilities Design end-to-end solution architecture across business, application, data, integration, security, and infrastructure domains. Translate business requirements into scalable, secure, and practical technology solutions. Ensure proposed solutions align with Enterprise Architecture, standards, and target architecture. Define current-state and target-state solution architecture and identify architectural gaps. Evaluate technology and solution options and provide architecture recommendations. Define application components, integrations, APIs, interfaces, and dependencies. Ensure interoperability between existing and new systems. Review solution designs and provide architecture recommendations and approvals. Ensure solutions comply with security, technology, regulatory, and organizational requirements. Identify technical risks, dependencies, constraints, and potential impacts. Collaborate with Business Architects, Application Architects, Data Architects, Security Architects, Infrastructure Architects, and technical teams. Participate in architecture governance and monitor compliance with approved architecture. Maintain architecture documentation, diagrams, standards, and architecture decision records. Support modernization, transformation, and application rationalization initiatives. Required Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in a relevant field. Work Environment This is a full-time, on-site position located in KSA, working within the Octopus by RTG team at robusta. The role involves close collaboration with various architectural and technical teams. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply for this Enterprise Solution Architect position.

4eb6035a2a6fa451.description: About the Role Parsons Corporation is seeking a Lead Sustainability Engineer to join the Construction Supervision Consultant (CSC) team for a major landmark development project in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves leading the implementation of sustainability strategies throughout the construction phase, ensuring adherence to project objectives, environmental requirements, green building standards, and client commitments. Key Responsibilities Lead and oversee sustainability implementation across all project construction activities. Monitor contractor compliance with project sustainability requirements, environmental management plans, and applicable regulations. Support the integration of sustainability principles into construction methodologies, procurement activities, and site operations. Review and assess contractor sustainability submissions, environmental plans, waste management plans, and sustainability reports. Conduct site inspections and audits to verify compliance with sustainability, environmental, and resource-efficiency requirements. Monitor sustainability performance metrics, including energy consumption, water efficiency, waste diversion, carbon reduction initiatives, and environmental compliance. Coordinate with contractors, designers, stakeholders, and project teams to resolve sustainability-related issues and achieve project objectives. Provide technical guidance on sustainable construction practices, environmental protection measures, and green building requirements. Support certification processes associated with sustainability frameworks such as LEED, ESTIDAMA, Mostadam, Envision, or equivalent rating systems. Prepare sustainability progress reports, compliance assessments, and executive summaries for the Client and Project Leadership Team. Support testing, commissioning, handover, and operational readiness activities to ensure sustainability objectives are achieved throughout the project lifecycle. Promote sustainability awareness and best practices across project teams and contractor organizations. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's Degree in Environmental Engineering, Sustainability Engineering, Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Architecture, or a related discipline. Minimum of 12 years of professional experience, with significant experience on major construction, infrastructure, or mixed-use developments. Proven experience leading sustainability initiatives during project delivery and construction supervision phases. Strong understanding of environmental management systems, sustainability frameworks, and green building standards. Experience with sustainability reporting, environmental compliance monitoring, and performance audits. Knowledge of energy efficiency, water conservation, waste management, circular economy principles, and carbon reduction strategies. Required Skills Strong leadership and stakeholder management abilities. Effective communication and report-writing skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Office and sustainability performance monitoring tools. Work Location This position is based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

4e3ba9e8a372d8e3.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة فون للتجارة عن بائع للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور على بيع مجموعة متنوعة من السلع والخدمات للعملاء، وتوفير معلومات دقيقة حول المنتجات، بالإضافة إلى إدارة عمليات الدفع والمخزون. هذه فرصة بدوام كامل تتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية بيع مجموعة من السلع والخدمات للعملاء بشكل فعال. توفير معلومات شاملة للعملاء تتعلق بالمنتجات، بما في ذلك استخداماتها وأسعارها. مراقبة مستويات المخزون بانتظام لضمان توفر المنتجات والحفاظ على ترتيب المتجر. إصدار طلبات شراء للمنتجات الجديدة والتعامل مع المنتجات الواردة بكفاءة. تولي أمور الدفع وتلقي المدفوعات من العملاء بدقة. معالجة طلبات استبدال المنتجات والمرتجعات وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المتبعة في المؤسسة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال المبيعات أو خدمة العملاء. القدرة على التعامل مع العملاء وتقديم معلومات واضحة عن المنتجات. مهارات جيدة في إدارة المخزون وترتيب المتجر. القدرة على التعامل مع أنظمة الدفع ومعالجة المعاملات المالية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويقع في مدينة جدة، ضمن منطقة مكة المكرمة. يتطلب العمل التفاعل المباشر مع العملاء وإدارة المهام اليومية المتعلقة بالمبيعات والمخزون في بيئة تجارية ديناميكية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة. مؤسسة فون للتجارة تلتزم بتوفير بيئة عمل احترافية وداعمة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور.

4e9bf6b80537c5d2.description: About the Role Ninja is seeking an experienced Invoice Matching Team Leader to join its warehouse-based operations team. This full-time role involves leading daily invoice matching, reconciliation, and exception resolution activities within a fast-paced warehouse environment. The ideal candidate will have 3-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Lead daily 3-way matching of supplier invoices against purchase orders (POs), goods received notes (GRNs), returns, and other supporting documents. Verify quantities, prices, item references, receiving status, and documentation before closing transactions. Investigate and resolve discrepancies related to invoices, quantities, receiving, returns, duplicates, and documentation. Coordinate with Receiving, Stock Control, Finance, Procurement/Commercial departments, and suppliers to resolve outstanding issues. Prioritize high-value, aged, and business-critical unmatched transactions, ensuring their timely closure. Allocate daily tasks and monitor team productivity, accuracy, workload, and completion rates. Review complex cases and provide coaching to team members on investigation and reconciliation procedures. Maintain accurate records, supporting documentation, and audit-ready reconciliations. Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) including matching completion, exception rate, ageing, accuracy, and closure time. Identify recurring issues and support initiatives for process improvement, standardization, and automation. Escalate material, unusual, or unsupported discrepancies to the relevant supervisor. Required Experience 3-5 years of experience in invoice matching, reconciliation, or a related financial operations role. Demonstrated experience in leading a team and coordinating daily operational activities. Work Environment This role is based within a warehouse environment, requiring active participation in daily operations to ensure efficient invoice matching and resolution processes. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply for this full-time position.

4eaca5c1dd015cb3.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة اوتاد الذوق للمقاولات المعمارية عن فني تدفئة وتهوية وتكييف للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تركيب وصيانة وإصلاح أنظمة التدفئة والتهوية وتكييف الهواء، بما في ذلك وحدات التدفئة ومضخاتها ومكيفات الهواء. المسؤوليات الرئيسية المساهمة في عملية تصميم نظم التهوية وتكييف الهواء والتدفئة، وتقديم المشورة بشأن المواد ومعايير الجودة. تقديم الدعم للمشروعات الهندسية، ومباشرة تنفيذ العمليات وتركيب النظم، ووضع جداول زمنية وتقديرات التكلفة. تقديم الدعم في أعمال الصيانة وتصليح النظم. مراقبة الجوانب الفنية المتصلة بإنتاج وتركيب واستعمال وصيانة منظومات وأجهزة ومعدات التدفئة والتهوية والتكييف للتأكد من دقة الأداء ومطابقة المواصفات. اتباع سياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال تركيب أو صيانة أو إصلاح معدات التكييف والتدفئة والتهوية. القدرة على العمل بفعالية ضمن فريق وفي بيئة عمل سريعة الوتيرة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في المدينة المنورة. سيعمل الفني ضمن فريق متخصص في مجال المقاولات المعمارية، مع التركيز على تطبيق أفضل الممارسات في الصحة والسلامة والبيئة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

4ec01c39d1abb1dd.description: المسمى الوظيفي: باريستا مسؤول عن تحضير وتقديم المشروبات الساخنة والباردة وفق الوصفات والمعايير المعتمدة، والمحافظة على جودة المنتجات وسرعة الخدمة، والالتزام بالنظافة الشخصية ونظافة منطقة العمل، وحسن التعامل مع العملاء، والتأكد من توفر المواد والأدوات اللازمة أثناء الشفت.

4e0aa567187c5399.description: نبذة عن الدور تعلن شركة منارة طابه لادارة وتشغيل الفنادق عن حاجتها لأخصائي عمليات موارد بشرية للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يركز هذا الدور على تنفيذ ومراقبة الإجراءات والأنظمة المتعلقة بدوام الموظفين وإجازاتهم، بالإضافة إلى تحديث بيانات الموظفين والتعامل مع استفساراتهم وشكواهم بمهنية عالية. يتطلب الدور إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتخصصة في مجال عمليات الموارد البشرية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تنفيذ الإجراءات والأنظمة والنماذج الخاصة بمراقبة دوام موظفي الفروع وإجازاتهم المتنوعة، وتعديل النماذج عند الحاجة. تطبيق نظام مراقبة الحضور والتأكد من التزام الموظفين بأوقات الدوام الرسمي. تطبيق سياسات وإجراءات الإجازات السنوية والمرضية والطارئة وغيرها من الإجازات المحددة في سياسة العطل والإجازات المعتمدة. تطبيق إجراءات الترقيات والإعارة وانتهاء الخدمة، وتسجيل كافة وقوعات الموظفين وفقاً للأنظمة والإجراءات المعتمدة. التعامل مع شكاوى وملاحظات وطلبات واستفسارات الموظفين بطريقة مهنية، ورفع المشاكل إلى مدير الإدارة عند الضرورة. تحديث المعلومات المتعلقة بالموظفين وتزويدها لفريق خدمات الموظفين، بما في ذلك تسجيل وتوثيق الترقيات والدورات التدريبية والأمور المتعلقة بالرواتب والامتيازات. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بعمليات الموارد البشرية، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة بعمليات الموارد البشرية. القدرة على تنفيذ الإجراءات والأنظمة بدقة. مهارات جيدة في التعامل مع الموظفين وحل المشكلات. القدرة على إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتخصصة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في المدينة المنورة. سيعمل أخصائي عمليات الموارد البشرية ضمن فريق متخصص لدعم العمليات اليومية للموارد البشرية في الشركة. معلومات إضافية المنطقة: المدينة المنورة. نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل. الراتب: لم يتم الإفصاح عنه.

4e4e531c443d4dc2.company_name: شركة غسان احمد السليمان لتجارة المفروشات
4e4e531c443d4dc2.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة غسان احمد السليمان لتجارة المفروشات عن أمين صندوق للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على الإدارة المالية والتخطيط، بما في ذلك إدارة التدفقات النقدية والسيولة والتمويل. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة، ويهدف إلى ضمان الكفاءة المالية وتحليل المخاطر المرتبطة بها. المسؤوليات الرئيسية إدارة الأرصدة النقدية اليومية وتحليل التدفق النقدي من العمليات والاستثمار والتمويل. ضمان كفاية التدفقات النقدية وتوقع المدفوعات النقدية والتنبؤ بالمشكلات الناشئة عن محدودية التدفق النقدي. تحليل متطلبات رأس المال في العمليات التجارية والمعاملات والالتزامات الأخرى. تقديم الدعم في وضع سياسات وإجراءات الرقابة الداخلية المتعلقة بإدارة الموازنة والنقد والائتمان والمحاسبة. تحليل وإدارة المخاطر المرتبطة بالتدفقات النقدية، وإجراء تحليل الحساسية لتقييم تقلبات التدفقات النقدية فيما يتعلق بالمخاطر التشغيلية والتمويلية. تحليل وتحديد خيارات شروط التمويل لتتناسب مع الاحتياجات التشغيلية والاستثمارية، والسعي للحصول على مصادر التمويل والتفاوض حول شروطها. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على إدارة التخطيط المالي وتحليل السيولة وسعر الفائدة والعملة والمخاطر المرتبطة بذلك. بيئة العمل يعمل أمين الصندوق بدوام كامل في مقر الشركة بالمدينة المنورة. يتطلب الدور التعاون مع الأقسام المالية الأخرى لضمان سير العمليات بسلاسة وكفاءة. معلومات إضافية هذه فرصة للانضمام إلى فريق عمل متخصص في شركة غسان احمد السليمان لتجارة المفروشات. الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

4e5a007426589896.description: About the Role KBR, Inc. is seeking an Associate Project Manager Engineering to join their team in Al Khobar, Eastern region. This is a full-time position responsible for overseeing all phases of planning and execution for medium-sized projects, typically those with a total installed cost of less than $100 million. The role may also involve managing a specific segment of a larger project. Key Responsibilities Plan, organize, coordinate, and control projects in adherence to established company policies, procedures, systems, and approved requirements. Serve as the primary day-to-day contact and communication point with the client, focusing on ensuring client satisfaction. Supervise personnel assigned to the project through subordinate leaders. May also function as the proposal manager for medium-sized projects. Qualifications and Experience An undergraduate degree in Engineering is required. A minimum of 10 years of related experience is necessary, with average experience typically ranging from 15 to 20 years. Demonstrated knowledge of the respective industry. Accountabilities This role includes budgetary accountabilities, requiring effective financial oversight and management within project parameters. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Al Khobar, within the Eastern region, contributing to KBR, Inc.'s engineering projects. Application Process We invite qualified candidates to apply for this opportunity. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

4e7a281332862b8f.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث الهيئة السعودية للمدن الصناعية ومناطق التقنية عن مدير مشروع للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى قيادة ومتابعة تنفيذ المشاريع ميدانياً، والإشراف على أداء الجهات المنفذة، مع ضمان توافق التنفيذ مع المخططات العامة المعتمدة. يضمن شاغل الوظيفة إنجاز المشاريع وفقاً لمعايير الجودة والجداول الزمنية والميزانيات المحددة. الهدف الوظيفي يتمثل الهدف الرئيسي لهذا الدور في قيادة ومتابعة تنفيذ المشاريع ميدانياً، والإشراف الفعال على أداء الجهات المنفذة. يضمن مدير المشروع مواءمة التنفيذ مع المخططات العامة المعتمدة، مما يسهم في إنجاز المشاريع بكفاءة عالية وفقاً لمعايير الجودة والجداول الزمنية والميزانية المحددة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية قيادة متابعة تنفيذ المشاريع ميدانياً من خلال الزيارات الدورية للمواقع ورصد سير الأعمال، لضمان مطابقة التنفيذ للمخططات والمواصفات المعتمدة. الإشراف على أداء المطورين والمشغلين والاستشاريين والمقاولين من خلال مراجعة التقارير الدورية وعقد اجتماعات المتابعة، لضمان الالتزام بالشروط التعاقدية ومتطلبات الهيئة. متابعة نسب الإنجاز والجداول الزمنية من خلال تحليل التقدم الفعلي مقارنةً بالمخطط ورصد الانحرافات، لدعم اتخاذ الإجراءات التصحيحية في الوقت المناسب. ضمان جودة التنفيذ من خلال مراجعة نتائج الفحوصات والاختبارات والتحقق من تطبيق معايير الجودة، لضمان تسليم مشاريع مطابقة للمواصفات. إدارة المعوقات والمخاطر من خلال تحديدها وتقييم أثرها والتنسيق مع الجهات المعنية لمعالجتها، للحد من تأثيرها على سير التنفيذ. ضمان مواءمة التنفيذ مع المخططات العامة من خلال التنسيق مع فرق التخطيط ومراجعة المتطلبات الفنية والاعتمادات، لتحقيق التكامل بين التخطيط والتنفيذ. المشاركة في أعمال التخطيط ومراجعة المخططات من خلال تقديم المدخلات الفنية المستندة إلى واقع التنفيذ الميداني، لرفع جودة المخرجات وقابليتها للتطبيق. إعداد تقارير أداء المشاريع الدورية للإدارة من خلال تحليل البيانات الميدانية وعرض التوصيات، لدعم اتخاذ القرار المبني على البيانات. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 6 إلى 10 سنوات في إدارة المشاريع. فهم عميق لعمليات تنفيذ المشاريع الميدانية. القدرة على الإشراف على أداء الجهات المنفذة المتعددة. مهارات ممتازة في متابعة الجداول الزمنية والميزانيات. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الرياض، وتتطلب تواجداً ميدانياً لمتابعة سير المشاريع والإشراف عليها. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن. ندعو المرشحين المؤهلين لتقديم طلباتهم.

4ee0256dd0d575db.job_title: Client Advisor Luxury Watches Jewelry and Fashion
4ee0256dd0d575db.description: About the Role Trafalgar Luxury Group is seeking a Client Advisor specializing in Luxury Watches, Jewelry, and Fashion to join our retail team. This full-time position is based in Makkah, with opportunities in Jeddah and Makkah, and requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. The role focuses on providing exceptional customer service and contributing to the overall success of our stores. Role Overview As a Client Advisor, you will be an integral part of the retail operations, primarily responsible for assisting customers, driving sales, and ensuring a positive shopping experience. This involves understanding customer needs, providing detailed product information, and maintaining store standards. Key Responsibilities Offer product information and guidance to customers within the stores. Understand customer needs and preferences to recommend suitable products or services. Demonstrate in-depth knowledge of products and services, including features, benefits, and usage. Build and maintain a customer database, with a focus on following up with VIP clients. Ensure a clean and organized store environment, including restocking shelves and arranging merchandise displays. Process transactions accurately using the point-of-sale (POS) system, handling various payment methods. Address customer inquiries, concerns, and complaints professionally and promptly, escalating to management when necessary. Collaborate with team members to achieve sales targets and contribute to store success. Stay informed about current promotions, sales campaigns, and new product launches to effectively communicate with customers. Participate in ongoing training and development programs to enhance product knowledge and sales skills. Manage after-sales service processes. Required Experience A minimum of 2 to 5 years of experience in a client advisory or retail sales role, preferably within luxury goods. Work Environment and Location This is a full-time position within a retail setting. The primary location for this role is Makkah, with operations also extending to Jeddah. The Client Advisor will work as part of a dedicated retail team to deliver high standards of service. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be disclosed during the interview process.

4e0fa00656347a29.description: About the Role Jazeera Paints is seeking a Showroom Sales Representative for a full-time position in Khaybar. This role is responsible for implementing the showroom sales plan to achieve assigned sales targets and ensuring a high standard of customer service. Key Responsibilities Welcome customers, provide high-standard service, and address their needs. Manage product handovers and provide pre-sales and after-sales support. Supervise showroom operations and inventory, ensuring compliance with company policies. Assist customers from product introduction and requirement identification to color coordination and product selection. Ensure accurate order processing, invoicing, and product delivery. Coordinate showroom personnel activities for efficient operations. Maintain showroom cleanliness, organization, and overall presentation. Ensure availability of marketing materials such as brochures and catalogs. Achieve assigned sales targets and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). Process online customer orders and update the e-commerce platform. Ensure adequate stock availability, especially for fast-moving items. Apply stock replenishment procedures by requesting products from warehouses based on established stock levels. Comply with the First-In, First-Out (FIFO) principle to minimize obsolete inventory. Report missing or unavailable products at the central warehouse to the direct manager. Report damage, equipment malfunctions, or maintenance requirements and follow up on corrective actions. Conduct inventory counts, reconcile physical balances, and report discrepancies. Complete daily closing processes accurately and on time, including handling customer advance payments. Execute assigned marketing programs and initiatives, including product campaigns and field visits. Maintain showroom appearance and ensure employee compliance with uniform and dress code requirements. Promote and sell all company product ranges to maximize sales opportunities. Ensure availability and proper condition of safety equipment, including valid licenses, fire extinguishers, and company vehicle maintenance. Implement and comply with the company's Ashanak program terms and conditions. Adhere to company policies, procedures, and established guidelines. Execute functions using safe and environmentally sound methods. Perform other duties as assigned by the direct supervisor or manager. Company Overview Jazeera Paints is a leading company committed to providing high-quality products and services. The company emphasizes compliance with established policies and procedures to ensure efficient operations and customer satisfaction. Work Environment and Compliance The role involves working within a showroom environment, coordinating with various personnel, and ensuring adherence to company standards for safety, operational efficiency, and customer service. Compliance with all internal policies, procedures, and external regulatory requirements is essential. Application Process Candidates interested in this full-time Showroom Sales Representative position are encouraged to apply. Further details regarding the application process will be provided upon inquiry.

4e34144fefea68e2.description: About Al Tuwairqi Group Al Tuwairqi Group is seeking a Storeman to join their team in Dammam. This full-time position is ideal for individuals with 0-1 year of experience who are looking to contribute to efficient material management and store operations. Role Overview The Storeman is responsible for the systematic receipt, storage, and issuance of materials within the warehouse. This role also encompasses maintaining high standards of cleanliness and organization across all store areas, including offices, washrooms, kitchens, and storage locations. The Storeman operates under the direct guidance of the Foreman, Storekeeper, or Store Officer. Key Responsibilities Unload incoming materials, either manually or using a forklift when an operator is available, considering the nature of the materials. Transfer materials from the receiving area to their designated main warehouse locations as per instructions from superiors. Re-arrange warehouse materials as necessary, following direct guidance from the Foreman, Storekeeper, Storage Operator, or other store superiors. Affix identification tags to materials in accordance with established guidelines. Perform cleaning and housekeeping duties for all store offices, washrooms, and kitchens, ensuring neatness and cleanliness, including warehouse storage areas. Prepare and serve tea for store staff as required. Conduct daily housekeeping in the stores and yards, including storage areas, bins, locations, and offices. Maintaining cleanliness and neatness is a direct and ongoing responsibility. Utilize all safety methods and procedures when handling materials. Assist the Storekeeper in the issuance of materials to users. Provide assistance to the Foreman or Storekeeper with general office tasks. Follow detailed work instructions provided separately for specific tasks. Support physical material issuance, receipts, and movements as advised by store superiors. Qualifications and Experience 0-1 year of experience in a similar role. Ability to perform manual labor and operate a forklift (if certified). Strong commitment to safety protocols and procedures. Ability to follow detailed instructions and work effectively within a team. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Dammam, requiring active participation in warehouse operations and a commitment to maintaining a clean and organized work environment.

4e5551684bcdbbf0.description: About the Role Maison Pyramide is seeking an Administrative Coordinator to support the smooth day-to-day operations of its office in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves front desk coordination, comprehensive administrative and HR assistance, and general operational support for the team. Key Responsibilities Manage the front desk, professionally welcoming visitors, clients, candidates, and suppliers. Handle incoming calls, deliveries, couriers, and general office inquiries. Ensure the office is organized, presentable, and operates smoothly daily. Monitor and replenish office supplies, stationery, pantry items, and other necessities. Coordinate with building management, maintenance teams, cleaning services, and external suppliers. Provide day-to-day administrative support to management and the wider team. Assist with calendar coordination, meeting arrangements, appointments, and reservations. Support travel arrangements, including flights, hotels, transportation, and itineraries. Maintain and update internal trackers, reports, and administrative records. Support with Uber Business reports and other company-related administrative platforms. Prepare documents, letters, presentations, and other materials as required. Assist with employee onboarding and offboarding requirements. Maintain and organize employee records and documentation. Prepare and track custody forms for company equipment and assets. Support with attendance, leave records, employee documentation, and other HR-related administrative tasks. Assist with employee engagement activities and internal team initiatives. Support the Events, PR, and wider teams with administrative and logistical requirements. Coordinate couriers, deliveries, transportation, bookings, and other operational needs. Assist with arrangements for meetings, events, and company activities. Liaise with suppliers and vendors, following up on requests, quotations, and deliveries. Provide on-ground support to different departments when required. General Responsibilities Maintain confidentiality when handling employee and company information. Ensure administrative documents and records are properly organized and up to date. Proactively follow up on pending tasks and requests. Support the team with ad hoc administrative and operational requirements. Perform any additional duties required to support the smooth running of the office. Candidate Profile The ideal candidate will be highly organized, proactive, and detail-oriented. This role requires comfort working in a fast-paced environment and coordinating effectively with various departments and senior management.

4eba9cdd4296d4f6.description: About the Role Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking a Senior Manager - Development (MAS102) to lead the planning, coordination, and execution of master development initiatives. This full-time role supports the successful delivery of large-scale destination, mixed-use, real estate, and infrastructure developments. The Senior Manager will manage development activities across the project lifecycle, ensuring alignment between master plans, business objectives, commercial requirements, stakeholder expectations, and delivery strategies. Key Responsibilities Lead development activities for assigned master development districts, precincts, or strategic development programs. Manage the translation of master planning objectives into actionable development strategies and implementation plans. Coordinate feasibility studies, market assessments, development programs, phasing strategies, and business case evaluations. Drive development planning activities in collaboration with Planning, Design, Engineering, Infrastructure, Commercial, and Delivery teams. Monitor development schedules, milestones, risks, dependencies, and critical development requirements. Support land use planning, development control processes, density assessments, and development optimization initiatives. Lead engagement with government entities, regulatory authorities, utility providers, and strategic stakeholders to secure approvals and development requirements. Coordinate consultants, advisors, and specialist service providers involved in master development activities. Support financial assessments, development feasibility analyses, investment evaluations, and commercial recommendations. Identify development risks, constraints, and opportunities and implement mitigation or value enhancement measures. Prepare executive reports, development updates, governance submissions, and strategic recommendations for leadership review. Mentor and support development team members while promoting collaboration and development excellence. Required Experience and Qualifications Candidates should possess 5-10 years of experience in relevant development roles. The ideal candidate will demonstrate experience in: Managing large-scale master-planned developments, mixed-use projects, destination developments, or urban regeneration initiatives. Coordinating multidisciplinary teams across planning, design, commercial, and delivery functions. Supporting development feasibility, investment evaluations, and implementation strategies. Engaging with government authorities, regulatory agencies, consultants, and strategic partners. Delivering complex development programs from concept planning through implementation readiness. Application Process The salary for this position will be disclosed during the interview process.

4e46fa6572f7fa83.description: About the Role Boutique Group is seeking a Hair Stylist to deliver personalized and technically precise hair services in Riyadh. This full-time role focuses on ensuring every guest looks and feels their best, maintaining the calm and discreet spirit of najmoon. The successful candidate will uphold established guiding documents, including "living our legacy," the "najmoon code of conduct," "forbes travel guide standards," "brand standards," and all SOPs and treatment protocols. Key Responsibilities Conduct comprehensive consultations before each service, covering hair and scalp condition, history, allergies, and guest preferences. Deliver cuts, blow-dries, styling, color, and hair treatments in accordance with najmoon standards. Adapt services to individual guest needs while adhering to agreed standards. Stay informed about current hair trends and techniques. Ensure smooth handovers with hair assistants and salon receptionists. Guest Personalization and Care Listen attentively and anticipate guest needs proactively. Maintain discretion and a calm demeanor at all times, allowing conversation to follow the guest's lead. Record guest preferences and formulas accurately in their profiles. Station Management and Retail Prepare the styling station to full standard before each guest. Maintain cleanliness, organization, and readiness of tools, products, and the station. Utilize correct product amounts and ensure proper care for all tools and equipment. Introduce home care products as a continuation of the salon experience. Provide clear aftercare and styling advice to guests. Professional Conduct and Compliance Arrive punctually and prepared for every shift, completing services within scheduled times. Uphold stringent hygiene standards, including cleaning and disinfecting tools between guests as required by law and najmoon policies. Handle and store color and chemical products safely according to instructions. Actively participate in all training sessions, briefings, and team meetings. Report any incidents involving guests or ambassadors to the najmoon assistant manager without delay, following the code of conduct's escalation chain. Demonstrate flexibility with scheduling, support other areas of najmoon when necessary, and work autonomously. 4e7e3fb6c3b7efd9.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة ريتاج الخضراء للخدمات عن مصورة فوتوغرافية للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة. يمثل هذا الدور فرصة للمهتمين بالتصوير الفوتوغرافي للعمل ضمن فريق يركز على إنتاج صور عالية الجودة لدعم أبحاث السوق. ستساهم المصورة في التقاط صور تعكس رؤية الشركة وتدعم تعزيز العلامة التجارية. سياق الوظيفة ستعمل المصورة الفوتوغرافية في بيئة إبداعية، حيث ستتاح لها فرصة لتطوير مهاراتها الفنية والتقنية. يهدف الدور إلى توفير صور تسهم في فهم السوق وتوجهات العملاء، مما يدعم الشركات في اتخاذ قرارات مستنيرة. سيتم توفير التدريب والدعم اللازمين لتحسين المهارات في التصوير. المهام والمسؤوليات التقاط صور عالية الجودة للمنتجات والفعاليات بما يتوافق مع رؤية الشركة ويعزز العلامة التجارية. التعاون مع فرق التسويق والبحث لتحديد احتياجات الصور وتقديم حلول إبداعية. تحرير الصور باستخدام برامج مثل Adobe Photoshop وLightroom لضمان الجودة العالية والامتثال لمعايير الشركة. إدارة وتنظيم أرشيف الصور لتسهيل الوصول والاستخدام من قبل فرق العمل المختلفة. تقديم أفكار لتحسين جودة الصور وزيادة تأثيرها على الجمهور المستهدف. التفاعل مع العملاء لفهم متطلباتهم وتوقعاتهم لإنتاج صور تلبيها. تطوير المهارات الفنية والتقنية من خلال التدريب المستمر ومتابعة أحدث التوجهات في مجال التصوير. المشاركة في اجتماعات الفريق لتبادل الأفكار والملاحظات حول المشاريع. تقديم الدعم الفني والتقني لأعضاء الفريق عند الحاجة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال التصوير الفوتوغرافي. شغف بالتصوير الفوتوغرافي واهتمام بالتفاصيل. القدرة على استخدام برامج تحرير الصور مثل Adobe Photoshop وLightroom. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق والتعاون مع الأقسام المختلفة. نوع العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة جدة. معلومات إضافية الراتب غير معلن. سيتم توفير التدريب والدعم المستمر للمصورة الفوتوغرافية لتطوير مهاراتها المهنية والفنية.

4e21109dda917e72.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة شبرا الطائف التجارية عن أمين مستودع فني للانضمام إلى فريقها في الطائف، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إدارة عمليات المستودع، بما في ذلك استلام المواد وتخزينها وصرف الطلبات، مع ضمان الالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات المنظمة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال ذي صلة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية استلام المواد الواردة إلى المستودع ومطابقة كمياتها ومواصفاتها، ثم تخزينها بما يتوافق مع طبيعتها ومعايير الحفظ المحددة. تحديد وتأمين الأدوات والمستلزمات والأجهزة والمعدات الضرورية لسير العمل بكفاءة، مع الالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات المعمول بها. إعداد مذكرات استلام المعدات والأجهزة الفنية من الشركات المتخصصة. صرف الطلبات الواردة من الجهات المختصة بناءً على المستندات النظامية، وتجهيز وشحن الأجهزة وقطع الغيار إلى الجهات الرسمية الطالبة. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية، وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في إدارة المستودعات أو مجال مشابه. القدرة على مطابقة الكميات والمواصفات بدقة. معرفة جيدة بسياسات وإجراءات تخزين المواد وصرفها. القدرة على إعداد التقارير وتوثيق العمليات. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الطائف بمنطقة مكة المكرمة. سيعمل أمين المستودع الفني ضمن فريق متخصص لضمان كفاءة عمليات المستودع وتلبية احتياجات الجهات المختلفة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم الإفصاح عنه خلال مراحل المقابلة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور.

4e9b7e2f6c105fe3.description: About My Clinic KSA My Clinic KSA is a leading multispecialty outpatient care provider in Saudi Arabia, established in 2017. The organization is committed to innovation and core values of care, collaboration, ambition, and responsibility, aiming to help individuals live healthier lives. Role Summary My Clinic KSA is seeking a Senior Database and System Administrator for a full-time position in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This role is responsible for providing comprehensive database and system administration support to ensure the availability, performance, integrity, and security of the organization’s databases and server infrastructure. A primary focus will be on databases supporting the Hospital Information System (HIS), as well as other clinical, business, and corporate applications. The administrator will work closely with application, infrastructure, and business teams to maintain stable, secure, and high-performing systems that support uninterrupted hospital operations. Key Responsibilities Administer, install, configure, upgrade, and patch database platforms, primarily Microsoft SQL Server, for HIS and other applications. Monitor database performance, capacity, and availability, proactively tuning queries, indexes, and configurations. Design, implement, and regularly test backup, restore, and disaster recovery procedures to meet RPO/RTO objectives. Implement and maintain high availability and replication solutions such as Always On Availability Groups, clustering, and log shipping. Manage database security, including user access, roles, privileges, encryption, and auditing, in compliance with organizational policies and healthcare data privacy requirements. Perform routine database maintenance activities, including integrity checks, index maintenance, statistics updates, and housekeeping jobs. Support HIS upgrades, application releases, data migrations, and integrations by preparing environments and executing database scripts. Coordinate with application teams and vendors to review database changes, troubleshoot data-related issues, and conduct root cause analysis. Administer Windows and Linux servers, virtualization platforms (*, VMware, Hyper-V), and related storage, including provisioning, patching, and capacity planning. Manage Active Directory, group policies, user accounts, and core infrastructure services (DNS, DHCP, file and print) in coordination with the infrastructure team. Monitor server health, system logs, and security alerts, applying operating system and security patches according to change management procedures. Maintain accurate technical documentation, including database and server inventories, configurations, standard operating procedures, and recovery runbooks. Participate in on-call rotations and after-hours maintenance windows to ensure continuity of critical hospital systems. Contribute to IT audits, compliance reviews, and continuous improvement of database and system administration practices. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of experience in database and system administration. Demonstrated expertise in Microsoft SQL Server administration. Experience with Windows and Linux server administration and virtualization platforms (VMware, Hyper-V). Strong understanding of data security, backup, recovery, and high availability solutions. Work Location This role is based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia.
