4ed5d4d5ef721033.company_name: مؤسسة سليمان محمد عجرم العنزي للمقاولات
4ed5d4d5ef721033.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة التاج المضيئ للمقاولات عن مدير أشغال ومرافق عامة للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية تخطيط وتوجيه وتنسيق أنشطة إدارة المرافق في المنشأة، بما في ذلك المواقع المادية الحالية والمستقبلية، والتصاميم، والأثاث، بالإضافة إلى جداول أعمال الصيانة والتنظيف. المسؤوليات الرئيسية وضع الخطط والسياسات والاستراتيجيات الإدارية العامة لمرافق الشركة، والإشراف على تنفيذها. ضمان الالتزام بقواعد ولوائح الصحة والسلامة والبيئة، ومباشرة تنفيذها. مباشرة الأنشطة اليومية للمرافق في المنشأة، بما في ذلك المواقع المادية، والتصاميم، والأثاث. تخطيط الجداول الزمنية لأعمال الصيانة والتنظيف للمرافق. مباشرة أنشطة الصيانة وتنسيق عمليات التصليح لتقليل مدة التوقف عن العمل. اختيار الموظفين وتدريبهم والإشراف عليهم، ومراقبة أدائهم وسلوكهم مقارنةً بالأهداف المحددة. تخطيط أعمال الإنشاء والملحقات الجديدة، وإعداد العقود المتعلقة بالبناء ومراجعتها والموافقة عليها. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال إدارة المرافق أو الأشغال العامة. فهم قوي لمبادئ تخطيط المرافق والصيانة. القدرة على إدارة المشاريع وتنسيق الفرق. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات قيادية وإشرافية قوية. القدرة على وضع الخطط والاستراتيجيات وتنفيذها. مهارات ممتازة في التواصل والتنسيق. الالتزام بمعايير الصحة والسلامة والبيئة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في الرياض. سيعمل المدير ضمن فريق متخصص في بيئة ديناميكية تتطلب التخطيط الفعال والإشراف المستمر على جميع جوانب المرافق. التقديم ندعو المهتمين والذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور.

4ee55f71f195c7eb.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الحبيب للتجارة والتعهدات التجارية عن منقذ سباحة للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى ضمان سلامة الأفراد في المسابح والأماكن المائية من خلال المراقبة المستمرة والاستجابة السريعة لأي حالات طارئة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الإنقاذ المائي. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية مراقبة المسابح والأماكن المائية بشكل دائم لضمان سلامة جميع الأفراد. استطلاع مواقع السباحة، مثل المسابح والبحيرات، لتحديد أي مخاطر محتملة والتعامل معها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. الاستجابة الفورية لأي مؤشرات تدل على حدوث حالة غرق أو خطر مائي. تقديم الإسعافات الأولية وعمليات الإنقاذ المناسبة للغريق، مع الأخذ في الاعتبار حالة المصاب. توجيه السباحين وتقديم النصائح حول الاستخدام الآمن لألواح الغطس والمنزلقات المائية، وتزويدهم بمعلومات حول احتياطات السلامة. إعداد التقارير الفنية الدورية حول الإنجازات ورفعها إلى المسؤول المختص. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الإنقاذ المائي. القدرة على تنفيذ كافة الأعمال المتعلقة برقابة المسابح والأماكن المائية. معرفة جيدة بإجراءات وسياسات السلامة المائية. القدرة على تقديم الإسعافات الأولية وعمليات الإنقاذ بفعالية. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات مراقبة ممتازة وانتباه للتفاصيل. القدرة على اتخاذ قرارات سريعة وفعالة في حالات الطوارئ. مهارات تواصل جيدة لتقديم النصائح والإرشادات للسباحين. القدرة على إعداد التقارير الفنية بوضوح ودقة. بيئة العمل يقع هذا الدور في مكة المكرمة، المملكة العربية السعودية، وهو وظيفة بدوام كامل. سيعمل منقذ السباحة ضمن فريق متخصص لضمان أعلى معايير السلامة في المرافق المائية. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين المؤهلين لمناقشة تفاصيل الدور.

4e479e3d1f1f51a1.company_name: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology
4e479e3d1f1f51a1.description: About the Role King Abdullah University of Science & Technology (KAUST) is seeking a Career Development & Internship Lead. This full-time position, located in King Abdullah Economic City, involves providing career counseling, professional development, and internship support to KAUST students. The role focuses on helping students identify and pursue career pathways aligned with their skills, interests, academic backgrounds, and professional goals, with an experience requirement of 5-10 years. Position Summary The Career Development & Internship Lead provides direct, student-centered career advising across KAUST's graduate and academic programs. This includes assisting students in developing effective career plans, preparing for employment and further professional opportunities, and building the necessary skills and networks for successful transitions into industry, academia, entrepreneurship, and other professional pathways. The role also involves developing and expanding internship opportunities for KAUST students by engaging with employers and external organizations to identify placements, facilitate connections, and support the internship process. Key Responsibilities Provide individualized career counseling and advising, covering career exploration, job search strategies, CV/resume development, cover letters, interviewing, networking, and professional branding. Help students translate academic, research, technical, and transferable skills into competencies valued by employers. Support the development and expansion of high-quality internship opportunities in Saudi Arabia and internationally. Identify potential internship hosts, engage with organizations to understand their talent needs, and match students with relevant opportunities. Coordinate with faculty and academic divisions to ensure internships align with student academic and professional development. Plan, coordinate, and deliver career development workshops, seminars, and information sessions on topics such as job searching, professional communication, and workplace readiness. Track student engagement, advising activity, internship applications, placements, and employer participation to monitor career service outcomes. Collect and analyze student and employer feedback to identify opportunities for improving career services and internship programs. Develop strong working relationships with faculty and academic staff to understand student career needs and promote participation in career and internship programs. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5-10 years of relevant professional experience. Demonstrated ability to provide career counseling and professional development support to students. Experience in developing and expanding internship opportunities and facilitating student-employer connections. Strong understanding of career pathways across various sectors including industry, academia, and entrepreneurship. Skills and Attributes Excellent interpersonal and communication skills for advising students and engaging with external partners. Ability to develop and maintain a database of internship opportunities and employer contacts. Strong organizational skills to coordinate internship processes and monitor experiences. Capacity to collaborate effectively with academic divisions, faculty, student services, and alumni. Commitment to a student-centered approach that is accessible, inclusive, and responsive to diverse student needs. Work Environment The Career Development & Internship Lead will work under the direction of the Head, Career Development & Industry Partnerships. The role involves close collaboration with academic divisions, faculty, student services, and alumni and graduate employment colleagues to ensure coordinated and high-quality career support. This full-time position is based in King Abdullah Economic City.

4e5ca48eecc27c9d.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة نبراس الخليج للنقليات عن أخصائي قانوني للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تنفيذ ومتابعة الأعمال القانونية للمنشأة، وتقديم الدعم والاستشارات القانونية لضمان حماية مصالح الشركة والامتثال للأنظمة المعمول بها. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في المجال القانوني. المسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد وصياغة ومراجعة العقود والاتفاقيات والخطابات والمراسلات القانونية. تقديم الاستشارات والآراء القانونية للإدارات المختلفة لضمان الالتزام بالأنظمة واللوائح. مراجعة المستندات والوثائق القانونية والتحقق من سلامتها واكتمالها. متابعة القضايا والمطالبات القانونية والتنسيق مع المحامين والمستشارين القانونيين. إعداد الإنذارات والإشعارات القانونية ومتابعة الإجراءات المتعلقة بها. دراسة وتحليل الأنظمة واللوائح والتحديثات التشريعية ذات الصلة بنشاط المنشأة. متابعة الالتزامات التعاقدية والتأكد من توافقها مع الأنظمة والسياسات الداخلية. المساهمة في معالجة النزاعات والخلافات القانونية والعمل على إيجاد الحلول المناسبة. إعداد المذكرات والتقارير القانونية ورفع التوصيات للإدارة المختصة. متابعة المعاملات والإجراءات لدى الجهات الحكومية وشبه الحكومية ذات العلاقة. حفظ وتنظيم وأرشفة الوثائق والعقود والسجلات القانونية. تقديم الدعم القانوني للإدارات الداخلية والموارد البشرية فيما يتعلق بالإجراءات والقرارات ذات الصبغة القانونية. المهام التشغيلية يتولى الأخصائي القانوني مسؤولية تنفيذ ومتابعة الأعمال القانونية اليومية، بما في ذلك إعداد وصياغة ومراجعة العقود والاتفاقيات والخطابات القانونية. كما يقدم الاستشارات والدعم القانوني لمختلف الإدارات، ويتابع القضايا والمطالبات والنزاعات، ويعد الإنذارات والإشعارات القانونية. يشمل الدور مراجعة المستندات والالتزامات التعاقدية، ومتابعة الأنظمة واللوائح ذات العلاقة، وقد يتطلب زيارة الجهات المختصة عند الضرورة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال قانوني ذي صلة. القدرة على إعداد وصياغة ومراجعة العقود والوثائق القانونية بدقة. معرفة بالأنظمة واللوائح القانونية المعمول بها. مهارات تحليلية قوية والقدرة على تقديم الاستشارات القانونية. بيئة العمل يعمل الأخصائي القانوني ضمن فريق شركة نبراس الخليج للنقليات في الرياض، في بيئة عمل بدوام كامل. يتطلب الدور التفاعل المستمر مع الإدارات الداخلية والجهات الخارجية لضمان الامتثال القانوني وحماية مصالح الشركة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقدم لهذا الدور في شركة نبراس الخليج للنقليات.

4e7a7a069e6c1740.description: About Tamara Tamara is a prominent fintech platform operating in Saudi Arabia and the GCC region. The company is seeking a People Business Partner to join its People team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position requiring 2-5 years of experience. Role Overview The People Business Partner will provide both tactical and strategic consulting on people and organization development strategies, aligning with business objectives. This role involves contributing to the development and implementation of HR policies and programs, with responsibilities spanning employee relations, policy interpretation, performance and compensation management, and talent management consultation. Key Responsibilities Provide HR partnership and support for strategic and tactical initiatives, including day-to-day HR assistance and strategy execution for assigned business groups. Foster and maintain effective relationships with leaders and employees, offering guidance on HR and business issues. Influence and coach leaders and managers to achieve business objectives within assigned populations. Manage employee relations and act as a change agent by implementing best practices and improving work relationships. Manage talent development and succession planning, identifying performance gaps and training needs for departments, managers, and employees. Maintain in-depth knowledge of compliance requirements related to day-to-day employee management, ensuring regulatory compliance, and collaborating with legal/compliance departments as needed. Implement HR best practices for key HR processes such as performance management, compensation planning, workforce/capability planning, and talent management. Identify training, coaching, and mentoring needs for departments, managers, and employees. Partner with other HR team members, including International HR, Immigration, and Payroll, acting as a point of contact and liaison to deliver comprehensive HR services. Required Qualifications and Experience Previous experience in coaching employees and management through complex issues. Proven strong foundation and knowledge of HR principles and practices, including employment law and compliance requirements. Demonstrated client management and business acumen. Strong communication and negotiation skills. Ability to thrive in an ambiguous and rapidly changing environment. Ability to set high personal goals and work independently. Ability to organize, multi-task, and prioritize tasks effectively. Ability to make recommendations to effectively resolve problems or issues, with demonstrated project management skills. Candidate Profile The ideal candidate is driven, determined, and curious, possessing a positive outlook and a solution-oriented approach. The role requires perseverance and the ability to work effectively with diverse individuals through empathy and respect, responding quickly and adapting without losing momentum.

4e35f98cb30b6783.description: We are seeking a dynamic and results-oriented Sales Representative to join our growing team and drive revenue growth. The ideal candidate will be responsible for identifying and pursuing new sales opportunities, building strong customer relationships, and exceeding sales targets. Key responsibilities include: * Developing and implementing effective sales strategies. * Prospecting and qualifying leads through various channels. * Presenting and demonstrating product/service value to potential clients. * Negotiating and closing deals to achieve sales quotas. * Maintaining accurate sales records and customer information.

4eaf32e95973bad9.description: About the Role Ethra For Human Resources Consulting is seeking a highly experienced Marketing & Branding Director to lead and oversee the marketing and branding strategy for their client within the Sports, Fitness & Wellness sector. This full-time position is based in Jeddah and requires a minimum of 10 years of experience. The role focuses on shaping, elevating, and protecting the company's brand across 72 active clubs, driving B2C marketing initiatives, and supporting business growth. Key Responsibilities Lead the development of the overall marketing and branding strategy, ensuring alignment with the company's vision and business goals. Conduct brand health analysis, consumer insights studies, and competitor benchmarking to inform strategic decisions. Manage the marketing and branding budget, optimizing spending for maximum ROI. Establish high-impact brand partnerships, sponsorships, and collaborations to enhance brand visibility. Oversee the full brand ecosystem, including identity, guidelines, tone of voice, and visual assets. Ensure consistent and premium brand image across all communication touchpoints, including digital, social media, and retail. Lead the creation of integrated creative campaigns to drive brand awareness, engagement, and customer loyalty. Oversee all marketing activities, including digital marketing, SEO/SEM, performance marketing, and CRM. Develop data-driven campaign strategies focused on B2C customer acquisition and retention. Monitor marketing KPIs and performance analytics, identifying opportunities for optimization. Shape external and internal communication strategies, overseeing PR campaigns and media relations. Lead, inspire, and mentor a team of marketing, creative, and branding professionals, including 8 direct reports, and manage external agencies. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business Administration, Media, Digital Marketing, or a related field. Minimum of 10 years of total work experience. At least 8 years of relevant experience in Brand Management, Digital Marketing, Content, Campaign Management, CRM Analytics, or Marketing Communications. Relevant experience in Retail, Hospitality, FMCG, or other consumer-facing sectors is required. Minimum of 5 years of direct people-management or equivalent leadership experience. Strong experience in marketing and branding strategy, with a focus on strategic business growth. Demonstrated B2C marketing experience, particularly in customer/member engagement, activations, and marketing campaigns. Experience in digital marketing and social media strategy, including platforms like Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook. Experience managing marketing activities and campaigns across multiple branches or locations. Strong knowledge of brand management, creative leadership, and project management. Excellent communication, storytelling, and presentation skills, with strong English communication skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience in the Sports & Fitness industry is highly preferred. Experience in B2B marketing is an advantage. Work Environment The successful candidate will oversee an in-house marketing team and manage relationships with external agencies, driving marketing and branding efforts across 72 active clubs. Application Process Candidates who meet the specified requirements are encouraged to apply for this leadership role in Jeddah.

4eabff6a3b9e2b15.description: About the Role Zahid Tractor is seeking a Junior Solar Project Engineer to join their team in Jeddah. This full-time position is ideal for candidates with m inimum of 1 years of experience, focusing on the design and technical assessment of small-scale solar PV systems. Role Summary The Junior Solar Project Engineer will be responsible for conducting site audit reviews and designing site-specific solar PV systems. This involves analyzing structural, solar shading, and electrical service aspects to ensure optimal system design and integration. Key Responsibilities Conduct site audits to gather structural, solar shading, electrical, and other relevant site information for designing small-scale residential, commercial, or industrial PV systems. Develop electrical single-line diagrams, panel schedules, and connection diagrams for solar electric systems using computer-aided design (CAD) software. Draft comprehensive system designs for PV projects, including site plans, single-line electrical drawings, specification of Balance of System (BOS) components, location and interconnection details, and appropriate labeling. Qualifications and Experience Minimum of 1 years of experience in a relevant field. Proficiency in using computer-aided design (CAD) software for electrical and system design. Understanding of solar PV system components and design principles. Work Type and Location This is a full-time position based in Jeddah. The role requires on-site work for conducting audits and collaborating with the engineering team. Application Process Further details regarding the application process and salary will be provided to qualified candidates.

4eeaa374d7d1c84d.description: About the Role HUDSON is seeking an experienced Welding Inspector to join a reputable company in Dammam, Eastern Province, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position requiring a strong background in the Oil & Gas sector. Key Responsibilities Perform welding inspections in accordance with approved project specifications, applicable codes, and quality standards. Inspect fit-up, joint preparation, root gap, alignment, and welding activities. Verify compliance with approved Welding Procedure Specifications (WPS) and Procedure Qualification Records (PQR). Check welder qualifications and ensure welding is performed by approved welders. Monitor preheating, interpass temperature, and post-weld heat treatment (PWHT), where applicable. Conduct visual inspection of completed welds and identify defects such as cracks, porosity, undercut, and incomplete fusion. Coordinate with NDT personnel for radiographic, ultrasonic, magnetic particle, and liquid penetrant testing, as applicable. Review welding drawings, inspection and test plans (ITPs), and method statements. Prepare inspection reports, maintain quality records, and raise non-conformance reports when required. Ensure compliance with project QA/QC requirements and applicable safety procedures. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of experience as a Welding Inspector. Demonstrated experience within the Oil & Gas industry. Work Location This role is based in Dammam, Eastern Province, Saudi Arabia.

4e025e5cb4b46434.job_title: Step Up Your Pastry Career: Junior Pastry Sous Chef
4e025e5cb4b46434.description: Job Overview The Career Nest is partnering with an upscale dining destination in Al Khobar, Eastern Province, known for its exceptional food and hospitality. This establishment is seeking a Junior Pastry Sous Chef to contribute to its pastry section. This is a full-time position with a salary of 7,000 SAR monthly. About the Role As a Junior Pastry Sous Chef, you will provide support to the Head Pastry Chef in managing the pastry section. The role involves taking ownership of daily production, which includes viennoiserie and plated desserts, while maintaining high quality standards. You will also be responsible for developing the junior team and leading the section when required. Key Responsibilities Execute classic and contemporary pastry techniques with precision and attention to presentation. Actively participate in motivating and developing the pastry team, maintaining discipline during busy services, and leading the section in the Head Pastry Chef's absence. Plan daily production, rigorously monitor shelf life, maintain strict FIFO and labeling standards, and flawlessly execute freezing and defrosting procedures. Ensure every item meets strict standards for taste, texture, and visual appeal while keeping the workspace clean, safe, and compliant. Monitor stock levels, manage portion controls, and minimize waste, ensuring premium quality is maintained while controlling food costs. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of experience in a relevant pastry role. Demonstrated ability to maintain uncompromising quality in pastry production. Experience in developing and mentoring junior team members. Proficiency in classic and contemporary pastry techniques. Work Environment This role is based in Al Khobar, Eastern Province, within a casual neighborhood dining destination that emphasizes exceptional food and warm hospitality. The kitchen environment is upscale and focuses on executing tasks with quiet excellence and creativity. Application Information Candidates interested in this full-time Junior Pastry Sous Chef position are encouraged to apply. The role offers an opportunity to contribute to a respected dining establishment.

4e8d26f1a6e5cc85.description: About the Role Hilton is seeking an Accounts Receivable professional to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position is central to ensuring accurate billing and efficient payment collection, contributing to the overall financial health and operational efficiency of the hotel. The role supports the delivery of hospitality by maintaining precise financial records and managing guest-related transactions. Key Responsibilities Process invoices and commissions, including generating accurate invoices and ensuring timely payment or deduction of travel agent commissions. Maintain account accuracy by promptly posting charges and credits, and reconciling subsidiary ledgers with the general ledger. Monitor and collect payments, following up on outstanding balances to maintain positive cash flow and reduce overdue accounts. Resolve billing issues by investigating account discrepancies and coordinating with relevant teams to resolve disputes. Prepare and send statements, issuing timely account statements with a target of daily delivery. Review daily transactions, auditing the previous day’s charges for accuracy, proper documentation, and contractual compliance. Manage credit metrics, calculating monthly Days Sales Outstanding (DSO) and assisting with credit management reporting to support timely collections and financial accuracy. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 0-1 years of experience is required for this role. About Hilton Hilton is a global leader in hospitality, recognized for its workplace culture and commitment to guest experiences. The company has been repeatedly featured on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. Hilton focuses on providing exceptional experiences for both guests and team members, upholding its vision to deliver hospitality worldwide. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role operates within a supportive environment that values team members and their contributions to the company's mission.

4e3f81e9a2893ba6.description: Job Details Location: Al Khobar, Eastern Province, Saudi Arabia Position Type: Full-Time, Permanent Department: Front of House (Reporting to the Restaurant Manager) Compensation: 6,000 SAR Monthly About the Opportunity We are exclusively partnering with an exquisite, casual neighbourhood dining destination in Al Khobar where French Riviera spirit meets everyday city life. Known for exceptional food, warm hospitality, and executing simple things beautifully, this concept is looking for a polished Receptionist to act as the ultimate gatekeeper of the guest experience. The Role As the first point of contact, you are the face of the restaurant. You will manage reservations, warmly welcome and farewell guests, and ensure the flow of the dining room feels effortless from the moment the doors open. By seamlessly optimizing the seating plan, you will play a direct role in the restaurant's daily performance and atmosphere. Your Profile & Experience Experience: No prior experience is required—your personality, warmth, and natural charm matter most. Familiarity with hospitality reservation systems is a plus. Traits: Elegant, poised, and highly organized. You maintain composure and balance even when the room is full and the pace is fast. Language: English fluency (written and spoken) is mandatory. Additional language skills such as Arabic or French are a genuine advantage. Core Responsibilities Reservation Flow: Manage the waitlist, bookings, walk-ins, and seating arrangements with ease, ensuring every guest feels expected and the room's momentum stays consistent. Proactive Communication: Deliver warm in-person interactions and clear, professional phone etiquette. You anticipate needs naturally, such as taking initial drink orders while guiding guests to their tables. Organization & Profiling: Keep the guest list accurate, actively build detailed guest profiles, and maintain an immaculate reception area at all times.

4e4d4fa3f3daac3d.job_title: ENGINEER ELECTRICAL Fresh Graduate East Region
4e4d4fa3f3daac3d.description: About Alfanar Alfanar is a Saudi company with an international presence, specializing in the manufacturing and trading of a wide range of low, medium, and high voltage electrical products. The company's portfolio also includes conventional and renewable energy solutions, oil and gas, water treatment, infrastructure, technical services, and digital solutions. Alfanar's manufacturing operations are centered at Medinet alfanar Alsinaiya in Riyadh, a 700,000 square-meter complex equipped with modern facilities and staffed by skilled professionals. Role Overview Alfanar is seeking a Fresh Graduate Electrical Engineer to join its team in Dammam, Eastern Region. This full-time position is designed to plan, control, and monitor the execution of electrical-related project tasks efficiently, on time, and to quality standards, in alignment with defined policies and procedures to achieve departmental operational plans and developments. The role requires 0-1 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Perform erection, testing, and commissioning of Power/Distribution transformers at site and factory. Conduct troubleshooting, maintenance, and testing of power/distribution transformers. Inspect transformers upon arrival and perform necessary tests. Verify the availability of all accessories for the transformer. Check impact recorders and collect data from them. 4e36426c22e99b5d.description: Salla is looking for a Senior QA Engineer to take ownership of product quality across our platform. You will be expected to define the most suitable QA approach for our product and teams, including the testing strategy, tools, standards, and workflows. This approach should be flexible, not rigid: you will adapt the depth, type, and process of testing to fit each situation, whether it's an urgent hotfix, a major feature launch, or a high-risk change. This is a hands-on role covering both manual and automated testing. You will work closely with engineering, product, and DevOps teams to review requirements, define test strategies, perform manual and exploratory testing, and build reliable test automation using Playwright. Beyond identifying and resolving defects, you will analyze their root causes and implement preventive measures to reduce recurring issues. Responsibilities Own quality end to end, building it in early through requirement reviews, design discussions, and test strategy, through to the final go/no-go call on releases Define and continuously refine the QA approach, including testing standards, workflows, tools, and quality metrics. Adapt testing depth, process, and priorities to risk, timeline, and context rather than applying a one-size-fits-all process Decide what needs testing, how deeply, and with which approach (functional, regression, API, UI, performance, security, usability). Decide what stays manual and what gets automated, and know when enough is enough Perform thorough manual and exploratory testing on new features, finding what scripts miss: edge cases, unexpected user behavior, UX problems, and the UI details users notice (layout, states, responsiveness) Build and maintain Playwright (TypeScript/JavaScript) automation that runs in CI, catches real issues instead of just adding to a test count, and gives the team fast, trustworthy feedback Review code and pull requests properly: read them, question them, and push back when something isn't right Triage defects and investigate them in depth using browser DevTools (network, console, performance, storage) to find root causes, not just symptoms, and help the team prioritize what matters most Prevent recurring issues by identifying the pattern behind bugs, analyzing defect trends, and putting safeguards in place (tests, checks, process changes). Think ahead about how new features, scale, and changes will affect quality Use AI tools thoughtfully to speed up test creation, analysis, and debugging, and build AI-assisted workflows where they add value, while always validating the output Communicate risks clearly to developers, product managers, and leadership, with a recommendation rather than just a report Take initiative to spot gaps in our processes, tools, or product and drive improvements, while mentoring other QA engineers and raising the quality mindset across the team 5+ years of QA experience with real ownership of releases and quality decisions Strong experience in both manual and automated testing, and the judgment to balance the two Solid JavaScript and TypeScript skills, enough to write clean, maintainable Playwright automation and read application code with confidence Hands-on experience with Playwright (or strong experience with a similar framework plus a willingness to go deep on Playwright) Strong command of Git and GitHub: branching, pull requests, code reviews, and working within CI pipelines Deep understanding of testing types, techniques, and test design, and the judgment to choose the right one Flexibility to adjust your approach to different situations, avoiding rigid processes while keeping quality standards high Experience testing web, mobile, and APIs Comfort with browser DevTools for debugging and investigation Practical experience using AI in your work, and the critical thinking to know when to trust it and when not to A preventive mindset: you've fixed problems at their root, not just patched symptoms, and can give examples
